dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (This stone tablet looks a fair bit more recent than the rest of the ruins. It seems to have been set up not long ago.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (Although the inscription cannot be understood per se, a little observation reveals that the engraving is a map of the surrounding area.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (The tablet is also engraved with some complex pictures that have something to do with the giant crystal suspended before you...)
